correctness.rationale: Independently re-derived from polynomials only. (1) Committed intervals: all 9 exact Fraction sign changes verify (e.g. sqrt2 -959/25000000 vs +24449/100000000; rho9 -647476743/1e12 vs +14013773/1.25e11); sympy integer-Sturm V(lo)-V(hi)=1 for all 9; discriminants: quadratics 8,12,5,28; cubics -23,-44,-31,-108 (one real), rho9 81 (three real). Quadratics match classical periods [2],[1,2],[1],[1,1,1,4] exactly. (2) CF vectors: implemented independent exact Q_{k+1}(y)=y^d Q_k(m_k+1/y) chain with Fraction arithmetic; E1 exhaustive 2000/2000 on all 9 numbers PASS; E2 (Sturm uniqueness, own subresultant-free Fraction Sturm) + E4 Fraction links exhaustive 2000/2000 on all 5 cubics PASS (rho9 exhaustive also PASS) and sampled on quadratics PASS; coefficient bit-length grows to ~3100 bits, no degeneracy. (3) Cross-check: 3000-dps mpmath expansion agrees on all 2000 terms for all 5 cubics (500-dps diverges after ~460 terms, confirming need for high precision; 3000-dps mismatches 0/2000); plastic 97-term OEIS prefix matches exactly. (4) Tallies: counts sum to M=1999 on all rows; L1/chi2 recompute exactly (e.g. plastic L1 0.03310 chi2 4.09; tribonacci 0.03233/3.94); GK expectations -log2(1-1/(k+1)^2) verified. B values recompute (phi 1, sqrt2 2, sqrt7 4, cubics 4130-22054) and extremal uniquely phi. (5) Thetas: all lo>0, hi>=lo; stable complete-quotient check 1/(x_{k+1}+q_{k-1}/q_k) at 300-dps contains logged intervals at all reported minima (plastic k319 4.53e-05, tribonacci k1546 9.42e-05, r7 k745 4.88e-05, cbrt2 k1989 7.85e-05, rho9 k156 2.42e-04, phi k1 0.38196601 in [0.38196594,0.38196619], sqrt2 k1/k122) and periodic spot checks; error-bound consequence hi<q_k/q_{k+1} verified exhaustively for k<=1998 via exact Fraction(hi)*q_{k+1}<q_k (0 violations). Proof vs evidence distinguished: CF/tallies are exact-integer proof; theta brackets rely on certified tails + float widening (disclosed), spot-verified but not exhaustively formally re-proved. No material mis-inference found.

originality.rationale: Compared substantively, not by timestamp. Sibbertsen et al. 2208.14359 frames the open debated question (degree>2 GK/Khinchin fit via KLD) but publishes no fixed-polynomial 9x2000 exact vectors, convergent logs, per-number GK chi-square tallies, theta intervals, or smallest-B extremal. Zhuravleva 1406.0518 proves L(alpha)>=3/17 for Pisot fractional parts {xi alpha^n}, disjoint invariant/method from CF quotients/GK tallies/thetas. Wolf 1003.4015 tabulates prime-built transcendental-candidate CFs (measure-zero Khinchin exceptions), disjoint family with no GK/theta/extremal. OEIS A072117 records only ~97 plastic-constant CF terms (verified prefix match), not N=2000 vectors, tallies, thetas, or 9-number extremal. Adverse nearest OEIS A002945 (+b-file to 19999 for cbrt2 via PARI contfrac at fixed precision) already lists the cbrt2 quotient prefix uncertified, but publishes no proof chain, no GK L1/chi2, no theta intervals, no 9-number extremal; other cubic vectors (tribonacci/r7/rho9/plastic-2000) plus combined statistics remain unrecorded and are not mechanically implied by quadratic periodicity or Pisot-power results. The combined polynomial-committed CF+GK-chi2+theta+extremal artifact is therefore new.

value.rationale: Strongest self-contained headline (five certified cubic N=2000 CF vectors with re-tallied GK L1/chi2 and theta intervals as benchmark for the Sibbertsen open question) judged separately from quadratic textbook rows and from any unfinished census. Objects motivated before computation (smallest-height quadratic surds + canonical cubic Pisots: plastic, tribonacci, x^3-x^2-1, cbrt2, x^3-3x-1 largest root) as standard explicit test family for Hurwitz/Roth/GK badly-approximable tests; invariants (exact quotients, GK discrepancies, theta brackets, B) not known or mechanically implied (plastic only 97 terms known; cbrt2 prefix known only uncertified without statistics; tribonacci/r7/rho9 vectors, all GK chi2 3.9-12.9 vs quadratics 2144-9765, and all min-theta values unknown). Future researcher could reasonably need the precise fact (Roth/Hurwitz/GK testing, badly-approximable witnesses). Narrow exact datum is eligible per value guidance; certification alone is not the value — the missing concrete GK/theta data on explicit cubics is. Quadratic periodicity and phi B=1 are classical and do not erase the cubic headline. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.

checked_sources.finding: Open debated question whether degree>2 algebraics follow Khinchin/GK laws; KLD evidence of poor fit; no fixed 9-polynomial N=2000 exact CF vectors, convergent logs, per-number GK chi-square, theta constants, or smallest-B extremal.
L(alpha)>=3/17 for Pisot degree<=4 and explicit L for certain cubic Pisots for fractional parts {xi alpha^n}; disjoint from CF quotients, GK tallies, convergent thetas.
50-digit CFs of prime-built transcendental-candidate numbers as Khinchin/Levy exceptions; different objects, no GK tally, theta certificate, or algebraic extremal.
Plastic constant CF lists only ~97 terms (verified prefix match to table); no N=2000 vectors, statistics, thetas, or extremal.

ADVERSE: cbrt(2) CF with PARI b-file to 19999 terms (uncertified fixed-precision contfrac); lists quotient prefix only, no proof chain, no GK L1/chi2, no theta intervals, no extremal. Does not imply other cubic vectors or combined artifact.
Badly approximable iff bounded CF terms; quadratics periodic hence badly approximable; max c=1/sqrt(5) e.g. golden ratio. Confirms quadratic rows classical, does not imply cubic data.
